description: This file defines the class HTMLPurifier_Strategy_MakeWellFormed, which implements a strategy for processing and balancing HTML tokens to ensure well-formedness, including handling of tags, autoclosing, and error suppression within the HTMLPurifier library.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_Strategy_MakeWellFormed
